title: SQL Injection in VulnerableAppointmentRepository.findByDateRange
description: The findByDateRange method uses string concatenation for both startDate and endDate parameters. An attacker can inject SQL through either parameter by providing malicious date strings like '2024-01-01' OR '1'='1' -- to bypass date range filters and retrieve all appointments regardless of date.
impact: Full appointment data exfiltration across all date ranges. An attacker can bypass date range filters to retrieve all appointments regardless of date constraints.
mitigation: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries using $1 and $2 placeholders for startDate and endDate parameters respectively.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for SQL injection in findByDateRange method
